issues.description: The text description for 'BATTLEMAGE' is cut off at the bottom, making it incomplete and hard to read the full lore.  [and 6 more like it]
The pagination dots below 'DRUID' are partially obscured by the bottom edge of the card, making them appear cut off.
The text 'GROVE WARDEN' is partially obscured by the icon next to it, and the text 'ARA' is rendered on top of the icon.
The text 'SILT-READER MAI' is partially obscured by the icon next to it.  [and 1 more like it]
The text 'THE ROOT-BINDER' has low contrast against the dark background of the map, making it difficult to read.  [and 7 more like it]
The text 'SHRINE' below the 'A' icon has low contrast against the dark background of the map, making it difficult to read.
The card 'CINDER RUNNER' is duplicated and overlapping itself on the left side of the screen, making the text and card art difficult to distinguish.
The card 'HEARTWOOD RELIC' is duplicated and overlapping itself in the middle-left of the screen, making the text and card art difficult to distinguish.
The card 'SEALING LIGHT' is duplicated and overlapping itself in the middle-right of the screen, making the text and card art difficult to distinguish.
The text 'YOUR TURN' is rendered with low contrast against its dark background, making it difficult to read.
The text 'ROOT WA' on the last card in the hand is clipped, indicating that the full card name 'ROOT WARDEN' is not fully visible.

The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner has a '0' where a '0' (zero) or 'O' (letter O) is used, but it is likely intended to be a number zero for '0 BARROW'. This is a minor legibility issue.
The text 'ROOT WA' on the far right of the player's hand is clipped, indicating that the full card name 'ROOT WARDEN' does not fit within its designated display area.
The map in the top right corner has a question mark icon rendered on top of what appears to be a card slot or area, making the underlying UI element unclear.
The text 'Dig Ch:' under 'Rewards' is cut off, indicating it spills outside its intended display area or is truncated.
The text 'Turns taken: 1' has very low contrast against its dark background, making it difficult to read.
The text '34 DECK O BARROW' in the top right corner has very low contrast against its dark background, making it difficult to read.  [and 1 more like it]
The text 'SWORD' and 'DUSKEANG' in the bottom left corner have very low contrast against their dark background, making them difficult to read.
The text 'TRIKZOS | 25' in the bottom left corner has very low contrast against its dark background, making it difficult to read.
The text "+EMBER:1" under 'Fragments' in the 'Rewards forfeited' section is partially cut off, specifically the '1' is clipped.
The text "DECK O BARROW" in the top right corner is partially obscured by the edge of the screen or another UI element, making it difficult to read the 'O' and 'BARROW' fully.
The text "DUSKEANG" in the bottom left is partially obscured by the edge of the screen or another UI element, making it difficult to read the 'G' fully.
The text 'AMETMB' in the filter options appears to be a garbled or corrupted glyph where 'EMBER' was likely intended, as suggested by the surrounding filter options (VERD, TIDE, HOL, DAWN).
The text 'Owned 13 / 146' and 'Runes: 0' in the top right corner have very low contrast against the dark background, making them difficult to read.
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is very thin and almost blends into the background, making it hard to see and interact with.
The overall layout is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space in the middle of the screen and content (cards and text labels) crammed into the left and bottom sections. This looks unfinished.
The text 'VERE EMB TIDE HOL DAWN' is rendered on top of the colored badges, making it difficult to read the badges and the text itself.
The text 'ALL' is rendered on top of the 'ALL' badge, making it difficult to read the badge and the text itself.
The text 'Owned 13 / 146' and 'Runes: 0' have very low contrast against the dark background, making them hard to read.
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is partially rendered, appearing as a thin, dark gray line against the black background, which looks unfinished.
The text 'Diag' in the top-left corner is rendered on top of the background art without any container or clear purpose, making it look like a debug overlay that was left in.
The text 'Region 1' and 'Cards: 0' under 'Warrior' have very low contrast against their dark background, making them difficult to read.
The 'Delete' button text is partially obscured by the 'Continue' button's background, making it look misaligned or overlapping.
The text 'SEX' is present as a UI label, which is likely a placeholder or an error, as 'SFX' (Sound Effects) is the common term in game settings.
The text '80' next to the 'Music' slider is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.  [and 1 more like it]
The text '100' next to the 'SFX' (labeled 'SEX') slider is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.
The text 'Low' next to 'Graphics Quality' is very low contrast against the dark background, making it hard to read.
The text '0.1.0 (20bdfbf9)' in the bottom right corner is extremely low contrast against the dark background, making it almost illegible.
The scrollbar on the right side of the screen is present but there is no content to scroll, suggesting a layout issue or an unnecessary UI element.
The overall layout is severely unbalanced, with a large empty space on the right side of the screen while all interactive elements are crammed into the left, making it look unfinished.
